entries.title: Take our 2026 election coverage survey
entries.summary: As the 2026 election nears, we’re working to make election reporting more responsive, inclusive and useful for voters. Please take our survey!
entries.content:
As the 2026 election nears, we’re working to make election reporting more responsive, inclusive and useful for voters.

We plan to provide a variety of reporting and resources to help you feel informed about who’s on your ballot.

To help us know what questions to ask, please take the short survey below and tell us: What should candidates be focused on this election season?

If you have troubles with the form below, click here to take the survey on a new page.

entries.author: Tyler Dedrick
